text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki, who were 
performing in a volunteer play hosted by 
the academy, were at the hospital they 
were visiting.

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Big sis, are you gonna be 
Cinderella in today's play!?

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
You know, even though I can't do it 
anymore... I love dancing! I'm really 
looking forward to Cinderella's dance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Yes, please look forward to it. 
I will do my very best in this 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ardan-saaan, please get ready soon!

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... So beautiful and dignified. The 
vibe between you two really is just 
perfect for Cinderella and the Prince!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you both look really sharp!
Yeah, both of you look wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... That reminds me, Ardan-san. 
Please make sure you only put on the glass 
slipper right before going on stage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand. It would be disastrous if it 
were to shatter by some accident, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan gazes intently at the glass 
slipper placed at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry~! Like I explained before, 
I've adjusted the scene where Cinderella 
puts on the glass slipper so she barely 
moves!

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Like, take the ballroom scene—when the 
prince asks Cinderella to dance, she 
proudly and firmly turns him down! 
Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame we had to cut the dance 
routine, too, but... we can't risk letting 
the performers get hurt!
choice_data_list:
That's fine then, but... don't push 
yourself too hard, alright?

That's fine then, but... don't overdo it, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Leave it to me. Even if this stage 
requires glass slippers—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to handling things so they 
don't break, there is truly no one better 
suited than me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The play progressed smoothly... and soon 
arrived at the ballroom scene."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "May I have this dance, my lovely one?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...Yes, with pleasure."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Cinderella danced lightly. Gracefully 
smiling, all while balancing on glass 
slippers that could shatter at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Amazing. Dancing lightly like that... 
without putting any strain on her legs, is 
actually supposed to be really difficult.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Enough to make anyone grit their teeth in 
frustration... Yet she wears such a 
beautiful smile."

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, your dance, Big Sister... it's 
really so... so, so beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll be able to dance again. I 
really want to dance...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san, any more than this is...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, Princess!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Yaeno Muteki's quick thinking in 
sweeping Mejiro Ardan up into her arms, 
the curtain fell without the glass slipper 
ever shattering.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...To all the staff, Yaeno-san, and 
Trainer. I am truly sorry for acting so 
selfishly.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no! Personally, no one was hurt 
and it hyped up the stage, so I think it 
was great... but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show hope... to the children 
who cannot leave their hospital beds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to show them a girl cowering 
and giving up while clutching broken 
shoes; I wanted to show them the courage 
to take a step forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that... would be the absolute 
best I could do right now."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. The fighting spirit I 
felt from Ardan during the race... was 
identical to yours when you run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She was beautiful, noble, and above all, 
fierce. That is why I... wanted to meet 
that "utmost effort" with everything I 
had.
choice_data_list: True, that was a truly dazzling dance.
I'd like you to talk to me next time too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that truly what you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I figured it was such a futile 
struggle that you would understandably be 
exasperated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Did I... look that way to you—?"

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Big sister, there you are! 
Your Cinderella dance was amazing! So, 
I... wanted to thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You... came all the way from your hospital 
room to see me off? Hehe, I'm not one to 
talk, but you really are reckless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. If I was able to help 
you stand back on your feet even a little, 
then I am satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I was able to give her plenty 
of courage and energy to take the next 
step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was worried they might push 
themselves too far, so I firmly resolved 
to give them another warning later...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: We can think it through together, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am... so sorry... Yes, of course. I knew 
you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have just assumed they'd 
reject it; I should've consulted them 
beforehand. ...I am so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... and... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...If there is a next time... please 
think through it with me. I promise to 
consult you before anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan calmly admitted her mistake 
and apologized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And driven solely by her bubbling passion, 
a reckless Mejiro Ardan stepped forward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this blend of thoughtfulness and 
fiery passion is both her weakness and her 
greatest charm.
